from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = 7
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    if not pts:
        return out
    cr = sum(r for r, c in pts) / len(pts)
    cc = sum(c for r, c in pts) / len(pts)
    colors = {grid[r][c] for r, c in pts}
    for color in colors:
        cells = {(r, c) for r, c in pts if grid[r][c] == color}
        while cells:
            seed = next(iter(cells))
            comp = {seed}
            stack = [seed]
            cells.remove(seed)
            while stack:
                r, c = stack.pop()
                for dr in (-1, 1):
                    for dc in (-1, 1):
                        q = (r + dr, c + dc)
                        if q in cells:
                            cells.remove(q)
                            comp.add(q)
                            stack.append(q)
            if len(comp) < 2:
                continue
            ends = [p for p in comp if sum((p[0]+dr, p[1]+dc) in comp for dr in (-1,1) for dc in (-1,1)) <= 1]
            if len(ends) < 2:
                continue
            outer = max(ends, key=lambda p: (p[0]-cr)**2 + (p[1]-cc)**2)
            inner = min((q for q in comp if q != outer), key=lambda q: (q[0]-outer[0])**2 + (q[1]-outer[1])**2)
            dr, dc = outer[0]-inner[0], outer[1]-inner[1]
            r, c = outer[0]+dr, outer[1]+dc
            while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
                if out[r][c] == bg:
                    out[r][c] = color
                r += dr
                c += dc
    return out
'''
path=progdir/'task-2ad511f5.py'
path.write_text(code)
# demo sparse coordinates, 21x26
D=[[7]*26 for _ in range(21)]
for r,c,v in [(13,8,1),(14,9,1),(14,10,9),(15,9,4),(15,10,8),(16,11,8)]: D[r][c]=v
# Test the written function via importlib
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',path); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
do=mod.transform(D)
locations=[(r,c,do[r][c]) for r in range(21) for c in range(26) if do[r][c]!=7]
print(locations)
print('expected demo added:', [(r,c) for r in range(21) for c in range(26) if do[r][c]!=7 and D[r][c]==7])
